entry.focal: The hero proxy: a solid 6x3x4.5 m orange box standing on the floor ~10 m ahead, filling the centre of the frame like a wall across the SW channel. Behind it, top left, the blown-out cylinder of the slide shaft (60 m away) is the brightest thing.
entry.next_visible: No. There is no receding tube curve, the south bridge is hidden behind the hero box, and the only bright cue is the slide shaft far to the east.

reveal.focal: From the north bridge crown: the geyser island's squat orange vent box and a scatter of grey boulder and seat boxes. No plume and no vault opening. A huge black ceiling fills the top half.
reveal.next_visible: Weak. The island is visible but nothing on it is lit. The channel continuing east and west is unreadable.

concept.focal: Mid-ground: the hero box seen from the other side (dark brown). Left: two tall lantern slabs. The rows of lantern_float dots are the only lead lines. Upper right: the lit spiral stair and pavilion.
concept.next_visible: Partly. A dotted line of floating lanterns leads west, but there is no tube vault, no teal water and no bridge silhouette, so you cannot tell that this is a channel.

strip.focal: Frames 1 to 7 are dominated by the giant overexposed slide-shaft cylinder ahead and right. Floating lantern cubes are spread evenly across the floor.
strip.next_visible: Yes, too much so: the east mouth reads only through the over-bright shaft. You can never tell that you are walking beside water inside a low tube.

fixes.detail: lava_tube was ground-snapped (z -67.0 instead of the intended -63.3), so it is an opaque 4.5 m-high block in the channel. Replace it with an open arch/vault shell (inner clear height of about 4 m over the 6 m channel and the 2 m towpath) repeated along the W, S and E arcs (open on the north arc from x 104 to 124, per ceiling_profile). Without it, the space is an open hall, not a tube.
Add a pool_uplight row along water:w_lazy at the channel centre, spacing [6,10], z = bed + 0.05. The channel currently reads as dark floor at eye level; concept 12 is teal water glowing from below.

lantern_niche produced 0 objects (snap: wall finds no wall because the tube shell is missing). Once the shell exists, place them on the outer wall with spacing [5,9], and add irregular amber crack emissive strips on the tube ribs (concept 12).
45 lantern_float at spacing [3,6] on both sides make an evenly spread carpet of dots. Use [4,9], alternate the sides, and leave a 10-15 m dark gap every ~25 m so the light pools alternate.
47 boulder_rim on the inner bank at spacing [1.5,3.0] read as a continuous ring of grey boxes from the bridge (reveal). Use spacing [3,7] in clusters of 2-3, scale [0.6,1.2].

top_change: Build the tube: replace the floor-snapped hero box with a continuous low vault shell over the channel so every view becomes a receding curve, then light the water from below.
plausibility: The hero box was snapped to the floor (z -67 vs -63.3) and stands as a 4.5 m wall across the SW channel and towpath, so floaters would collide with it.
No 4 m tube roof exists. Eye-level views show the b3_cavern vault ~14 m up with stalactites, which contradicts 'low lava tube'.
entry_steps are 0.2 m-high stair proxies for 4 steps into a channel whose bed is at -68.4 (1.4 m below the towpath), so the steps do not reach the bed.
The slide-shaft cylinder (r 9 at 150,50) renders as a blown-out emissive surface that outshines everything in this space.
